```{=html}
<div id="ls-root">
<style>
#ls-root{font-size:20px;line-height:1.3;color:#222222;text-align:left;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 290px;gap:6px 18px;align-items:start}
#ls-root *{box-sizing:border-box}
#ls-root .ls-top{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#ls-root .ls-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px}
#ls-root .ls-tabs button{font:inherit;font-size:18px;padding:4px 14px;border:1px solid #bbbbbb;background:#ffffff;color:#444444;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer}
#ls-root .ls-tabs button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#1f4e9c;border-color:#1f4e9c;color:#ffffff}
#ls-root .ls-model{font-size:22px}
#ls-root .ls-plots{display:grid;gap:4px}
#ls-root svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
#ls-root .ls-panel{display:grid;gap:10px;font-size:17px}
#ls-root .ls-ctl label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;font-weight:600}
#ls-root .ls-ctl output{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:20px}
#ls-root input[type=range]{width:100%;margin:2px 0 0;accent-color:#1f4e9c}
#ls-root .ls-reset{font:inherit;font-size:15px;padding:4px 10px;border:1px solid #bbbbbb;background:#ffffff;color:#444444;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;justify-self:start}
#ls-root .ls-row{border-left:3px solid #cccccc;padding:1px 0 1px 10px}
#ls-root .ls-row.ls-m{border-color:#c0392b}
#ls-root .ls-row.ls-s{border-color:#e6a817}
#ls-root .ls-lab{color:#666666;font-size:15px}
#ls-root .ls-num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#ls-root .ls-name{font-size:18px}
#ls-root .ls-note{font-size:15px;color:#666666}
#ls-root button:focus-visible,#ls-root input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #7aa2e8;outline-offset:2px}
</style>

<div class="ls-top">
  <div class="ls-tabs">
    <button type="button" data-d="unif" aria-pressed="true">Uniform</button>
    <button type="button" data-d="norm" aria-pressed="false">Normal</button>
    <button type="button" data-d="expo" aria-pressed="false">Exponential</button>
  </div>
  <div class="ls-model" id="ls-model"></div>
</div>

<div class="ls-plots">
  <svg id="ls-pdf" viewBox="0 0 640 240" role="img" aria-label="Density of Y"></svg>
  <svg id="ls-cdf" viewBox="0 0 640 240" role="img" aria-label="CDF of Y"></svg>
</div>

<div class="ls-panel">
  <div class="ls-ctl">
    <label for="ls-a"><span>Location <em>a</em></span><output id="ls-aOut"></output></label>
    <input type="range" id="ls-a" min="-3" max="3" step="0.05" value="0">
  </div>
  <div class="ls-ctl">
    <label for="ls-b"><span>Scale <em>b</em></span><output id="ls-bOut"></output></label>
    <input type="range" id="ls-b" min="0.5" max="3" step="0.05" value="1">
  </div>
  <button type="button" class="ls-reset" id="ls-reset">Reset to <em>a</em> = 0, <em>b</em> = 1</button>
  <div id="ls-out"></div>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById('ls-root');
  const q = s => root.querySelector(s);
  const COL = { ink:'#222222', muted:'#666666', grid:'#e5e5e5', axis:'#999999',
    curve:'#1f4e9c', fill:'#1f4e9c', mean:'#c0392b', band:'#e6a817' };

  function erf(x){
    const s = x < 0 ? -1 : 1; x = Math.abs(x);
    const t = 1 / (1 + 0.3275911 * x);
    const p = ((((1.061405429 * t - 1.453152027) * t + 1.421413741) * t - 0.284496736) * t + 0.254829592) * t;
    return s * (1 - p * Math.exp(-x * x));
  }
  const fmt = (v, d = 2) => {
    let s = v.toFixed(d);
    if (/^-0(\.0+)?$/.test(s)) s = s.slice(1);
    return s.replace('-', '\u2212');
  };

  const D = {
    unif: { z:'Unif(0, 1)', EZ:0.5, VZ:1/12, EZs:'\u00bd', VZs:'1/12', SDs:'1/\u221a12',
      xmin:-4, xmax:7, xstep:1, ymax:2.2, ystep:0.5, bmax:3,
      pdf:z => (z >= 0 && z <= 1) ? 1 : 0,
      cdf:z => z <= 0 ? 0 : z >= 1 ? 1 : z,
      zb:[0, 1],
      name:(a,b) => `<em>Y</em> ~ Unif(${fmt(a)}, ${fmt(a + b)})`,
      note:'<em>a</em> is the left endpoint, <em>b</em> is the width.' },
    norm: { z:'N(0, 1)', EZ:0, VZ:1, EZs:'0', VZs:'1', SDs:'1',
      xmin:-10, xmax:10, xstep:2, ymax:0.9, ystep:0.2, bmax:2.5,
      pdf:z => Math.exp(-z*z/2) / Math.sqrt(2*Math.PI),
      cdf:z => 0.5 * (1 + erf(z / Math.SQRT2)),
      zb:[],
      name:(a,b) => `<em>Y</em> ~ N(\u03bc = ${fmt(a)}, \u03c3\u00b2 = ${fmt(b*b)})`,
      note:'<em>a</em> = \u03bc, <em>b</em> = \u03c3.' },
    expo: { z:'Exp(1)', EZ:1, VZ:1, EZs:'1', VZs:'1', SDs:'1',
      xmin:-4, xmax:14, xstep:2, ymax:2.2, ystep:0.5, bmax:2.5,
      pdf:z => z >= 0 ? Math.exp(-z) : 0,
      cdf:z => z >= 0 ? 1 - Math.exp(-z) : 0,
      zb:[0],
      name:(a,b) => Math.abs(a) < 1e-9
        ? `<em>Y</em> ~ Exp(\u03bb = 1/<em>b</em> = ${fmt(1/b)})`
        : `<em>Y</em> = ${fmt(a)} + Exp(\u03bb = ${fmt(1/b)}): shifted, not exponential`,
      note:'<em>b</em> = 1/\u03bb; <em>a</em> moves the start of the support.' }
  };
  const st = { d:'unif', a:0, b:1 };

  const W = 640, H = 240, M = { l:46, r:12, t:30, b:26 };
  const PW = W - M.l - M.r, PH = H - M.t - M.b;
  const ticks = (lo, hi, step) => { const o = []; for (let k = Math.ceil(lo/step - 1e-9); k*step <= hi + 1e-9; k++) o.push(+(k*step).toFixed(6)); return o; };
  const tstr = v => String(+v.toFixed(2)).replace('-', '\u2212');
  const r1 = v => v.toFixed(1);

  function plot(kind){
    const d = D[st.d], a = st.a, b = st.b;
    const ymax = kind === 'pdf' ? d.ymax : 1.05;
    const X = x => M.l + (x - d.xmin) / (d.xmax - d.xmin) * PW;
    const Y = y => M.t + PH - y / ymax * PH;
    const mean = a + b * d.EZ, sd = b * Math.sqrt(d.VZ);
    const id = 'ls-clip-' + kind;
    let s = `<defs><clipPath id="${id}"><rect x="${M.l}" y="${M.t - 2}" width="${PW}" height="${PH + 4}"/></clipPath></defs>`;

    // grid
    const yt = kind === 'pdf' ? ticks(0, d.ymax, d.ystep) : [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1];
    yt.forEach(v => {
      s += `<line x1="${M.l}" x2="${M.l + PW}" y1="${r1(Y(v))}" y2="${r1(Y(v))}" stroke="${v === 0 ? COL.axis : COL.grid}" stroke-width="1"/>`;
      s += `<text x="${M.l - 6}" y="${r1(Y(v))}" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="middle" font-size="12" fill="${COL.muted}">${tstr(v)}</text>`;
    });
    ticks(d.xmin, d.xmax, d.xstep).forEach(v => {
      s += `<line x1="${r1(X(v))}" x2="${r1(X(v))}" y1="${M.t}" y2="${M.t + PH}" stroke="${v === 0 ? COL.axis : COL.grid}" stroke-width="1"/>`;
      s += `<text x="${r1(X(v))}" y="${M.t + PH + 16}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="${COL.muted}">${tstr(v)}</text>`;
    });

    // mean ± 1 SD band
    s += `<g clip-path="url(#${id})"><rect x="${r1(X(mean - sd))}" y="${M.t}" width="${r1(X(mean + sd) - X(mean - sd))}" height="${PH}" fill="${COL.band}" fill-opacity="0.2"/>`;

    if (kind === 'pdf') {
      // split support at discontinuities; solid pieces, dashed verticals at jumps
      const f = y => d.pdf((y - a) / b) / b;
      const br = d.zb.map(z => a + b * z).filter(y => y > d.xmin && y < d.xmax);
      const cuts = [d.xmin, ...br, d.xmax], del = 1e-7, N = 300;
      const pieces = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < cuts.length - 1; i++) {
        const lo = cuts[i], hi = cuts[i + 1], pts = [];
        for (let k = 0; k <= N; k++) {
          const x = lo + (hi - lo) * k / N;
          const xe = Math.min(Math.max(x, lo + del), hi - del);
          pts.push([X(x), Y(f(xe))]);
        }
        pieces.push(pts);
      }
      const all = pieces.flat();
      s += `<path d="M${all.map(p => r1(p[0]) + ',' + r1(p[1])).join('L')}L${r1(X(d.xmax))},${r1(Y(0))}L${r1(X(d.xmin))},${r1(Y(0))}Z" fill="${COL.fill}" fill-opacity="0.12" stroke="none"/>`;
      pieces.forEach(pts => {
        s += `<path d="M${pts.map(p => r1(p[0]) + ',' + r1(p[1])).join('L')}" fill="none" stroke="${COL.curve}" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`;
      });
      br.forEach(y0 => {
        const yl = f(y0 - del), yr = f(y0 + del);
        s += `<line x1="${r1(X(y0))}" x2="${r1(X(y0))}" y1="${r1(Y(yl))}" y2="${r1(Y(yr))}" stroke="${COL.curve}" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>`;
      });
    } else {
      const F = y => d.cdf((y - a) / b), N = 600;
      let p = '';
      for (let k = 0; k <= N; k++) { const x = d.xmin + (d.xmax - d.xmin) * k / N; p += (k ? 'L' : 'M') + r1(X(x)) + ',' + r1(Y(F(x))); }
      s += `<path d="${p}" fill="none" stroke="${COL.curve}" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`;
    }

    // mean marker (solid; dashes are reserved for density jumps)
    s += `<line x1="${r1(X(mean))}" x2="${r1(X(mean))}" y1="${M.t}" y2="${M.t + PH}" stroke="${COL.mean}" stroke-width="2"/>`;
    if (kind === 'cdf') {
      s += `<circle cx="${r1(X(mean))}" cy="${r1(Y(d.cdf(d.EZ)))}" r="5" fill="#ffffff" stroke="${COL.mean}" stroke-width="2.5"/>`;
    }
    s += `</g>`;

    if (kind === 'pdf') {
      const right = X(mean) > M.l + PW * 0.6;
      s += `<text x="${r1(X(mean) + (right ? -7 : 7))}" y="${M.t + 14}" text-anchor="${right ? 'end' : 'start'}" font-size="15" font-style="italic" font-weight="600" fill="${COL.mean}" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" paint-order="stroke">E[Y] = ${fmt(mean)}</text>`;
      // legend
      const lx = M.l + PW - 250;
      s += `<line x1="${lx}" x2="${lx + 20}" y1="14" y2="14" stroke="${COL.mean}" stroke-width="2"/>`;
      s += `<text x="${lx + 26}" y="14" dominant-baseline="middle" font-size="13" fill="${COL.muted}">mean</text>`;
      s += `<rect x="${lx + 82}" y="7" width="20" height="14" fill="${COL.band}" fill-opacity="0.35"/>`;
      s += `<text x="${lx + 108}" y="14" dominant-baseline="middle" font-size="13" fill="${COL.muted}">mean \u00b1 1 SD</text>`;
    }
    s += `<text x="${M.l}" y="15" dominant-baseline="middle" font-size="16" font-style="italic" fill="${COL.ink}">${kind === 'pdf' ? 'Density' : 'CDF'} of Y</text>`;
    return s;
  }

  function render(){
    const d = D[st.d], a = st.a, b = st.b;
    const mean = a + b * d.EZ, vr = b * b * d.VZ, sd = b * Math.sqrt(d.VZ);
    q('#ls-model').innerHTML = `<em>Y</em> = <em>a</em> + <em>b Z</em>,&ensp;<em>Z</em> ~ ${d.z}`;
    q('#ls-aOut').textContent = fmt(a);
    q('#ls-bOut').textContent = fmt(b);
    q('#ls-pdf').innerHTML = plot('pdf');
    q('#ls-cdf').innerHTML = plot('cdf');
    q('#ls-out').innerHTML = `
      <div class="ls-name">${d.name(a, b)}</div>
      <div class="ls-row ls-m"><div class="ls-lab"><em>E</em>[<em>Y</em>] = <em>a</em> + <em>b E</em>[<em>Z</em>]</div>
        <div class="ls-num">${fmt(a)} + ${fmt(b)} \u00d7 ${d.EZs} = <b>${fmt(mean)}</b></div></div>
      <div class="ls-row"><div class="ls-lab">Var[<em>Y</em>] = <em>b</em>\u00b2 Var[<em>Z</em>]</div>
        <div class="ls-num">${fmt(b)}\u00b2 \u00d7 ${d.VZs} = <b>${fmt(vr, 3)}</b></div></div>
      <div class="ls-row ls-s"><div class="ls-lab">SD[<em>Y</em>] = <em>b</em> SD[<em>Z</em>]</div>
        <div class="ls-num">${fmt(b)} \u00d7 ${d.SDs} = <b>${fmt(sd, 3)}</b></div></div>
      <div class="ls-note">${d.note}</div>`;
  }

  function sync(){
    const A = q('#ls-a'), B = q('#ls-b');
    B.max = D[st.d].bmax;
    A.value = st.a; B.value = st.b;
  }
  root.querySelectorAll('.ls-tabs button').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    st.d = btn.dataset.d; st.a = 0; st.b = 1;
    root.querySelectorAll('.ls-tabs button').forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(x === btn)));
    sync(); render();
  }));
  q('#ls-a').addEventListener('input', e => { st.a = +e.target.value; render(); });
  q('#ls-b').addEventListener('input', e => { st.b = +e.target.value; render(); });
  q('#ls-reset').addEventListener('click', () => { st.a = 0; st.b = 1; sync(); render(); });
  sync(); render();
})();
</script>
</div>
```
